title: ArcaneEcho Enchantment
description: It is a mod that facilitates the location of ores using "echolocator"
body: Arcane Echo adds a powerful new enchantment to Minecraft that allows you to detect ores through magical vibrations. Enchant your pickaxe with Arcane Echo and unlock the ability to sense valuable minerals hidden beneath the earth. * Enchant a pickaxe with **Arcane Echo** (I, II, or III) * Hold the enchanted pickaxe * **Right-click** in the air to activate * Read the message to learn about nearby ores * Look for glowing block outlines (Level III shows direction) * Wait for cooldown before using again ### **The Arcane Echo Enchantment** * **3 Levels of Power**: Each level increases detection range, visual feedback, and reduces cooldown * **Exclusive to Pickaxes**: Only works on pickaxe tools * **Smart Detection**: Automatically prioritizes rare ores over common ones ### **Detection System** * **Right-click** your enchanted pickaxe to activate * Receive contextual messages about nearby ores * Higher levels provide directional hints (up, down, north, south, east, west) * Visual block highlights show exact ore locations through walls ### **Supported Ores** **Vanilla Minecraft:** * Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold * Redstone, Lapis Lazuli * Diamond, Emerald * Nether Quartz, Ancient Debris **Modded Ores (via tags):** * Aluminum, Lead, Nickel, Osmium * Platinum, Silver, Tin * Uranium, Zinc, Mithril ## 📊 Enchantment Levels | Level |Detection Radius |Visual Range |Cooldown |Duration | | ----- |---------------- |------------ |---------- |---------- | | I |6 blocks |3 blocks |30 seconds |3 seconds | | II |10 blocks |5 blocks |25 seconds |6 seconds | | III |16 blocks |8 blocks |20 seconds |10 seconds | _All values are configurable!_   Fully customizable through Forge config: * Detection radius for each level * Cooldown times * Maximum blocks to scan (performance tuning) * Sound effects toggle * Volume control
